title: Picker prompt addendum: instruct Claude to chain-reason over the RECENT_CAPTURES projection (#334 follow-up)
goal: #334 added a RECENT_CAPTURES section to the graph projection that shows the picker the last 5 captured_value entities (tokens, cookies, hostnames, etc.) with origin step + redacted preview. The data is now in the prompt but the system-prompt body never tells Claude HOW to use it for cross-target chain reasoning. Without an explicit instruction, Claude reads the section as background context rather than actionable lineage. This task adds a small instruction block — appended OUTSIDE the protected lines 1-200 of _AI_PICKER_SYSTEM_PROMPT — that explicitly directs the picker to reuse a previously-captured value when its kind matches a step's needed parameter (e.g., a captured token of kind=token becomes an Authorization header in the next task; a captured hostname becomes the target_id of a new pivot task).
scope: Append a single 10-15 line 'CHAIN REASONING ON RECENT_CAPTURES' addendum to _AI_PICKER_SYSTEM_PROMPT below line 300 (outside the must_not_touch range). Phrase it as guidance, not as a hard rule: 'When you see a RECENT_CAPTURES entry whose kind matches a parameter needed by a candidate step, prefer that value as the parameter source via interpolation rather than re-acquiring it.' Add 2 unit tests proving (a) the new addendum is present in the live prompt, (b) the addendum sits outside lines 1-200.
generation_reason: Identified during the 10-task deferred-capability audit. #334 task body explicitly noted '_AI_PICKER_SYSTEM_PROMPT body untouched (no system-prompt changes; the new RECENT_CAPTURES section appears in the dynamic graph projection block, which the picker already consumes via #323's plumbing).' But surfacing data without instructing the model how to use it is half a feature. Operator pushback 2026-05-17: 'Claude ziet de data maar weet niet ermee te chainen — de hele Mythos-differentiator (cross-target reasoning) is incompleet.'

constraints.scope_creep_guard: Append-only text addition outside lines 1-200. Do NOT modify the existing prompt body, do NOT add new tools, do NOT change the schema or output_config (#330 contract), do NOT change RECENT_CAPTURES section format itself.
